arguments.question: Assess ANET’s material geopolitical and trade-policy channels over the 5/21/63-session horizon. Read the dated January 15, 2026 advanced-computing rule and substantive issuer geographic/customer disclosures to determine only what is supported about export controls, China or other regional exposure, customer concentration, tariffs, and supply-chain restrictions. Distinguish revenue already excluded from management guidance from optional policy upside; do not infer that a rule applies to ANET without product/geography evidence. Deliver dated facts, conditional mechanisms, competing explanations, and observable policy/company-disclosure changes that would alter the assessment. Stop after the registered policy document and relevant filing excerpts; if company applicability or quantified exposure remains unavailable, state the narrow gap rather than broadening search.
arguments.decision_impact: Determines whether policy/geopolitical effects are a material current valuation or operating driver, merely conditional upside/downside, or unsupported—and prevents double-counting excluded revenue as incremental downside.
